task_name: `ce init` command, overwrite guard and CLI wiring

concerns_addressed: Phase-1 carry-forward still holds: packageJsonUnreadable is true for non-ENOENT package.json read errors (command.ts:144,153) and the actually-written name is passed as configPath to renderNextSteps (command.ts:218-220).
Windows rename/EPERM: untestable here; a failed rename leaves the original intact, unlinks the temp and exits 1 with 'Cannot write <name>: EPERM'. Non-blocking.
Symlinked ce.yml under --force replaces the link, not its target: matches spec B3.
Dangling-symlink --force now has a dedicated test (command.test.ts).

strengths: Function sizes now within limit: runInitCommand 194-232 (~39 lines); all other functions <= ~19 lines; file 232 lines.

Safety invariants unchanged: lstat guard before any non-force write, wx create, wx temp + rename under --force, temp unlinked on any failure, no success text on failure (writeConfig throws before stdout/notes).
Both-files note now printed only after a successful rename (command.ts:172).
lstat non-ENOENT errors now yield 'Cannot check <name>: <code>' exit 1 via ConfigCheckError; unknown errors still rethrown.
Directory lockfiles ignored via isFile check (command.ts:152).
No process.* in command.ts; detect/template/next-steps reused; init in cli.ts still does not load .env.
vitest src/init + cli.init.test: 118 passed; tsc --noEmit clean.

issues.description: Non-force create writes ce.yml directly with wx; a mid-write failure (e.g. ENOSPC) can leave a partial ce.yml that is not cleaned up (intentionally left as is by the fix round).
InitFs still adds readdir beyond the packet's declared deps contract; lockfile detection silently degrades when readdir fails.
ConfigCheckError and ConfigWriteError classes are declared after the functions that throw them (works at runtime since use is deferred, but reads out of order).

strategies: round 1: extract helpers from runInitCommand; fix lstat EACCES, note ordering, dir lockfile; add dangling-symlink --force test
